source: Seed material property table; values used as given. Fsy in the source table is derived as Fty/sqrt(3) (von Mises) -- carried through here. NO CTE in the source table: cte is unset, so the thermal-preload path (TFSR 5) cannot run for this entry until a coefficient is supplied. No Fbry either, so the bearing YIELD criterion reports NotEvaluated. INVAR CERT PER ASTM F1684-06 CTE 1.3e-06 1/degC is a REPRESENTATIVE HANDBOOK VALUE, not from the seed table (which has no CTE column) -- replace with a program allowable. Thermal-preload margins (TFSR 5) computed from it are traceable to this placeholder.
